title: ulmus campestris f. suberosa
intro: Ulmus campestris f. suberosa, commonly known as Cork Elm, is a subspecies of the Common Elm tree (Ulmus campestris) characterized by its unique corky bark. The health benefits of Cork Elm include its ability to help reduce inflammation and fever, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. Therapeutically, Cork Elm is known for its expectorant and anti-inflammatory actions, which can help to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Cork Elm include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
